drone.label: Simulated inspection feed
drone.note: The inspection plays pre-recorded stock drone clips, not a live feed, and PigeonOps does not control a drone. The inspection accuracy is an assumption that differs by the kind of check, used to test how much the recommendation depends on it.
drone.accuracy_basis: assumed for a dispatcher who reviews drone footage with a CV suggestion; not yet validated

cv_only.basis: Still-image CV alone (vehicle-spacing rule, not the motion rule used on the drone clips): detector error measured on 27 UAV-OBB frames (only 4 with dense traffic) combined with an assumed traffic link; regenerate with python -m cv.evaluate_road_state

web_triage.label: Web triage of public feeds
web_triage.note: P(finding | road state) for an agent that searches the CHP incident log, Caltrans message signs and NWS alerts near the reported spot. Assumed, not measured: a real blockage is often logged within minutes but not always, and an open road rarely produces a matching report. Treated as independent of the drone check.

rates.note: Non-driver truck operating cost per mile, loaded driver wage per hour and diesel tailpipe CO2 per mile. Round planning values, not measured for this fleet; see docs/METHODS.md.

blockage.note: If the road is blocked, a truck on the blocked route drives to the obstruction, loses turnaround_min in the queue, drives back to the route start and takes the fallback route.

assignment_pool.note: Shipments and trucks the dispatcher may reassign. Trucks' available_at times are synthetic. A reassigned truck leaves at its available_at, drives to the load (the position of the load's current truck) along a straight line stretched by fetch_circuity at fetch_speed_mph, waits until that truck is free, spends handover_min on the handover, then hauls the load from there on the shipment's route.
